info.title: Pitch Mentor API
info.description: Public API for Pitch Mentor. Authenticate with a team API key (`Authorization: Bearer pm_live_…` or `X-API-Key`). Lists use cursor pagination (`limit`, `cursor` → `{data, has_more, next_cursor}`); errors are `{error:{code,message}}`. Webhooks are signed per Standard Webhooks (`webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp`, `webhook-signature: v1,<base64 HMAC-SHA256>`).

CallCompletedData.description: The call record without the transcript (fetch it with GET /v1/calls/{id})

avgTalkRatio.description: Percent of talk time by the rep

prefix.description: First characters of the key, for recognition

key.description: The full key. Shown only once.

secret.description: whsec_… signing secret. Shown only once.

messageId.description: Sent as the webhook-id header; the same for replays

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key

Forbidden.description: API key lacks the required scope, or the action is not allowed

Conflict.description: A request with this Idempotency-Key is still in progress (`idempotency_in_progress`), or the resource is in a conflicting state (e.g. the API key is already revoked, or the team has no manager to send an invite from)

Unprocessable.description: The Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request body (`idempotency_mismatch`)

retry-after.description: Seconds until the current window resets

x-ratelimit-remaining.description: Requests left in the current window

x-ratelimit-reset.description: Unix time (seconds) when the current window resets

ServerError.description: Server error. Retrying a POST with the same Idempotency-Key is safe: failed requests are not replayed.
